questions.q: What is the capital of South Sudan?
questions.why: It is on the White Nile.

questions.q: In which year did South Sudan become independent?
questions.why: It is the world's newest widely recognised country.

questions.q: From which country did South Sudan separate?
questions.why: Almost 99% voted to leave.

questions.q: Who has been President of South Sudan since independence?
questions.why: He wears a famous cowboy hat.

questions.q: What is South Sudan's currency?
questions.why: It began in 2011.

questions.q: Which river flows through South Sudan?
questions.why: It passes through the Sudd swamp.

questions.q: Which resource makes up most of South Sudan's exports?
questions.why: It is piped through Sudan.

questions.q: Which rebel leader of the SPLM died in a 2005 helicopter crash?
questions.why: He had just become Vice-President of Sudan.

questions.q: Which civil war began in South Sudan in 2013?
questions.why: It was between Kiir and Machar's forces.

questions.q: Who is the long-time rival and sometime Vice-President?
questions.why: He was put on trial in 2025.

questions.q: Which movement led the fight for South Sudan's independence?
questions.why: It is now the ruling party.

questions.q: Which 2005 agreement led to the independence vote?
questions.why: It was signed in Kenya.

questions.q: Which disputed border area claimed by both Sudans is rich in oil?
questions.why: A vote on its future was never held.

questions.q: Which 1972 agreement ended the First Sudanese Civil War?
questions.why: It gave the south self-rule.

questions.q: Which 'Lost Boys' fled the war in the 1980s?
questions.why: Many later went to the US.

questions.q: Which huge swamp is one of the world's largest wetlands?
questions.why: It covers up to 57,000 square kilometres.

questions.q: Which people are famous for being among the tallest in the world?
questions.why: Many herd cattle.

questions.q: Which animal is central to many South Sudanese cultures?
questions.why: Cows are a sign of wealth.

questions.q: Which great animal migration happens in South Sudan?
questions.why: It is one of the largest on Earth.

questions.q: What is the official language of South Sudan?
questions.why: Juba Arabic is widely used.

questions.q: Which national park is home to the kob migration?
questions.why: It is near Ethiopia.

questions.q: Which basketball player born in South Sudan was a famous NBA shot-blocker?
questions.why: He was 2.31 m tall.

questions.q: Which British-born player of South Sudanese heritage starred for the Chicago Bulls?
questions.why: He was an NBA All-Star.

questions.q: In which team sport did South Sudan play at the 2024 Olympics?
questions.why: They nearly beat the USA in a warm-up.

questions.q: Which border park in the south has the Fula rapids?
questions.why: It is near Uganda.

questions.q: What is Mount Kinyeti?
questions.why: It is in the Imatong Mountains.

questions.q: Which model from South Sudan became famous in the 1990s?
questions.why: She was born in Wau.

questions.q: Which people perform scarification as a sign of adulthood?
questions.why: The marks run across the forehead.

questions.q: Which South Sudanese runner competed as a refugee at the 2016 Olympics?
questions.why: He ran the 800 m.

questions.q: Which cattle camp people sleep among their herds by the Nile?
questions.why: Their cattle have huge horns.
